verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is evidenced mainly through the official remote MCP server. It lets any MCP-capable AI assistant query incidents, analyze alerts, check who's on call and manage escalations, but this requires an external AI tool. A changelog line says users can now update the status page 'using the agent', which hints at a first-party conversational agent, but that is a single thin mention. missing for 10: documentation of a native in-product natural-language command interface and its scope (e.g. declaring/updating incidents by chat command), breadth of write operations available via natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration.
